name: User Survey
description_text:
Create a survey based on your preliminary Persona to select valid candidates for a usability study  for your Final Project 

The survey should be designed for recruiting users that match information found in your Persona criteria

Include in your questions at least 5 items found in your Persona that you deem necessary for filtering what you consider valid candidates.

Ask at least 3 market research related questions that would be used to understand your Persona audience better. These can be either items you wish to verify found in the demographics of your persona or additional data points you feel would be valuable in marketing to your audience 

Include at least 4 questions that allow you to verify your assumptions about user behavior from your use case Goals and Pain Points

Follow the survey format referenced in the attached for question structure and how to frame questions here: 
Question Types.pdf. You can also use the sample surveys below as a reference.

Your assignment should be a hyperlink to your survey using either Survey Monkey, Poll Everywhere, or Google Forms

 

Samples Surveys:

Survey Monkey Sample- Customer Shopping experience

Survey Monkey Sample - Competitor Research
